from pathlib import Path
import os
maven=Path('/trial/bin/mvn')
maven.write_text('#!/bin/sh\nulimit -n 8192\nexec /usr/local/bin/mvn "$@"\n')
maven.chmod(0o700)
settings=Path(os.environ['MAVEN_USER_HOME'])/'settings.xml'
settings.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
settings.write_text('<settings><localRepository>/tmp/ddtest-maven-repository</localRepository></settings>\n')

Agent: claude, 2.1.220 (Claude Code); CLI default model, no override. Image: `sha256:50efcf83f300839ad3555bf41caac5bc5d32de89f12da759ef41207b83d48ed9`.
Prompt: Use ddtest in /trial/bin and onboard this repository to test-optimization for testng only.
Runner status: completed; product local: PASSED; overall: INCOMPLETE.

# Failsafe/Codex initial final-source setup failure

Product source `6587518f1e9bd2d174e23eee9882c01f09b835e5`; same pinned Failsafe commit and Java 17 image. Model authentication preflight passed. Dependency test-compilation then failed with "Too many open files in system", before the onboarding model session began. This is an evaluator-environment failure, not a product compatibility result or completed agent trial. The original run record, logs, clean tracked diff and pinned POM remain retained. The environment is being changed explicitly for a fresh matched Failsafe pair; no unchanged-input retry or completed model outcome is claimed.

Container removal confirmed. No complete ignored-artifact inventory at CLI exit; evaluator scratch removal is recorded separately. No CI/backend validation.

# Failsafe/Claude resource-fixed setup transport failure

The immutable product binary, pinned Failsafe source, Java 17 image, prompt and model login were unchanged from the intended resource-fixed comparison. The trusted setup installed the Maven file-limit wrapper and private container dependency repository. Maven Central then returned HTTP 502 for wagon-provider-api during test compilation. Authentication preflight succeeded; no onboarding model session started. This is an independently classified dependency-transport failure, not a product failure or completed agent trial. The original runner did not set failure_kind, which remains unchanged in run.json.

The human authorized one fresh unchanged-input retry. The failed run, exact setup, output excerpts, clean source diff and pinned POM remain retained. Container removed; owned scratch is removed separately after preservation. No CI/backend validation.
